blocks.prompt: 5 A radioactive substance has a half-life of 2 years. If the initial quantity is 200 grams and the exponential decay function is \(Q(t) = Q\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^{\frac{t}{h}}\), then find the remaining quantity after 6 years graphically?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh radioactive decay (tabkari ka khatam hona) ka sawal hai: har half-life (yahan 2 saal) baad miqdaar aadhi reh jati hai.
Humein 6 saal baad bachi hui miqdaar find karni hai, aur woh graph se parhni hai.
Plan: formula mein \(Q_0 = 200\) aur \(h = 2\) rakhenge, 2 saal ke faaslon par table banayenge, curve kheenchenge, \(t = 6\) par value parhenge aur hisaab se tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: half-life \(h = 2\) saal, shuru ki miqdaar \(Q_0 = 200\) g, \(Q(t) = Q_0\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^{t/h}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(Q(6)\), \(Q(t)\) ke graph se.
Tareeqa: numbers ke saath model likhenge, table banayenge, smooth curve kheenchenge aur \(t = 6\) par parhenge.
Note: kitab exponent ko bohat chhota chhaapti hai; yeh \(t/h\) hai, jahan \(h\) half-life hai. Yahan \(h = 2\) hai, is liye dono soorton mein exponent \(t/2\) hi banta hai.

Model likhein
\[Q(t) = 200\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^{t/2}\]
Kyun: aage wala number shuru ki miqdaar hai: \(t = 0\) par \((\tfrac{1}{2})^0 = 1\), is liye \(Q(0) = 200\). Aur \(h = 2\) half-life hai: har 2 saal mein power 1 barhti hai, yani miqdaar aik dafa aadhi hoti hai.

Table banayein (t = 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10)
\[t:\ 0,\ 2,\ 4,\ 6,\ 8,\ 10\]
\[Q:\ 200,\ 100,\ 50,\ 25,\ 12.5,\ 6.25\]
Kyun: half-life ke multiples lene se power \(t/2\) poora number banti hai, aur har value pichhli ki aadhi hoti hai. Misaal: \(t = 4\) par power 2, \((\tfrac{1}{2})^2 = \tfrac{1}{4}\), aur \(200 \times \tfrac{1}{4} = 50\).

Graph banayein
Scale: t-axis par 1 square = 1 saal, Q-axis par 1 square = 25 g. Points laga kar smooth curve se jorein.
Curve \((0, 200)\) se shuru hoti hai, shuru mein tezi se girti hai, phir aahista aahista, aur t-axis ke qareeb hoti jati hai magar usay kabhi chhooti nahin.
Kyun: exponential decay mein miqdaar kabhi bilkul zero nahin hoti; har 2 saal baad jo bacha hai us ka aadha khatam hota hai. Is liye t-axis aik asymptote (aisi line jis ke qareeb curve jati hai lekin milti nahin) hai.
Dhyan dein: points ko seedhi lines se na jorein; yeh curve hai, line nahin.

Graph se jawab parhein
Horizontal axis par \(t = 6\) se seedha upar curve tak jayein, phir wahan se left mein Q-axis tak: reading 25 g hai.
Kyun: sawal mein "graphically" likha hai, is liye jawab graph se parh kar dikhana zaroori hai; dotted lines se parhne ka tareeqa saaf nazar aata hai.

Hisaab se tasdeeq
\[Q(6) = 200\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^{3}\]
\[= 200 \times \dfrac{1}{8} = 25\]
Doosra tareeqa: 6 saal = 3 half-lives, \(200 \to 100 \to 50 \to 25\).
Kyun: hisaab aur graph dono aik hi jawab dete hain, is liye 25 g pakka hai. Half-life wala tareeqa formula ke baghair bhi jaldi check kar deta hai.
Dhyan dein: kuch students \(200 \times \tfrac{1}{2} \times 6\) ya \(200 - 3 \times 50\) jaisa hisaab kar lete hain. Yeh ghalat hai: decay mein har dafa pichhli miqdaar ka aadha hota hai, aik hi miqdaar baar baar nahin ghatti. Is liye power wala formula ya baar baar aadha karna hi sahi tareeqa hai.
Asal zindagi mein yahi tareeqa carbon dating mein purani cheezon ki umar nikaalne aur hospitals mein radioactive dawaon ki miqdaar ka hisaab lagane mein kaam aata hai.
blocks.final_answer: 6 saal baad \(25\) grams miqdaar baqi rehti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab decay function ko \(Q(t) = Q\left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{t/h}\) likhti hai, yani shuru ki miqdaar ke liye bhi wohi harf Q. Durust shakal \(Q(t) = Q_0\left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{t/h}\) hai, jahan \(Q_0 = 200\) g shuru ki miqdaar aur \(h = 2\) saal half-life hai. Answer key (safha 296) mein yeh jawab number "8" ("25 grams") ke saath chhapa hai; value sahi hai.
